findings.location: Third paragraph, sentence ending and direct address
findings.source_quote: Together, we share and learn how to effectively communicate what is in our hearts, and through the power of the written word, transmit those thoughts to your hearts.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the address consistent in number and person. Change "vuestros corazones" to "nuestros corazones" (or to "sus corazones" if a polite plural is preferred) so it matches the preceding "Juntos, compartimos y aprendemos". Example: "...y, mediante el poder de la palabra escrita, transmitir esos pensamientos a nuestros corazones."
findings.translation_quote: Juntos, compartimos y aprendemos cómo comunicar eficazmente lo que hay en nuestros corazones, y mediante el poder de la palabra escrita, transmitir esos pensamientos a vuestros corazones.
